mapper.select:
select A.SCENE_FTR_ID AS SCENEFTRID, NULL AS SCENEFTRTIPSID, A.SCENE_ID AS SCENEID, A.FTR_ID AS FTRID, A.FTR_VALUE_STRUCT AS FTRVALUESTRUCT, A.FTR_VALUE AS FTRVALUE, A.FTR_VALUE_TYPE AS FTRVALUETYPE, B1.PARAM_VALUE AS MIXFTR, B2.PARAM_VALUE AS ASSETTYPE1, B3.PARAM_VALUE AS ASSETTYPE2, B4.PARAM_VALUE AS ASSETTYPE3 from STT_SCENE_FACTOR A LEFT JOIN STT_SCENE_FTRTIPS B1 ON A.SCENE_FTR_ID = B1.SCENE_FTRTIPS_ID LEFT JOIN STT_SCENE_FTRTIPS B2 ON A.SCENE_FTR_ID = B2.SCENE_FTR_ID LEFT JOIN STT_SCENE_FTRTIPS B3 ON A.SCENE_FTR_ID = B3.SCENE_FTR_ID LEFT JOIN STT_SCENE_FTRTIPS B4 ON A.SCENE_FTR_ID = B4.SCENE_FTR_ID where A.FTR_VALUE is null AND B1.DICT_CODE = #{mixCode} AND B2.PARAM_CODE = '04' AND B2.DICT_CODE = 'ASSETTYPE1' AND B3.PARAM_CODE = '04' AND B3.DICT_CODE = 'ASSETTYPE2' AND B4.PARAM_CODE = '04' AND B4.DICT_CODE = 'ASSETTYPE3'
and A.SCENE_ID =#{sceneId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select t1.ftr_id as ftrId, t1.ftr_name as ftrName, t1.ftr_value_struct as frtValueStruct, t3.tips_value as ftrTypeCode, t2.tips_value as ftrType2Code, IFNULL(t4.type_5,IFNULL(t4.type_4, IFNULL(t4.type_3, IFNULL(t4.type_2, t4.type_1)))) as AssetType from stt_factor t1 join stt_factor_tips t2 on t1.ftr_id = t2.ftr_id left join stt_factor_tips t3 on t1.ftr_id = t3.ftr_id left join stt_type_fac_ref t4 on t1.ftr_id = t4.fac_id where t2.dict_code = #{ftrType2, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t2.tips_value in ${ftrType2Str} and t3.dict_code = #{ftrType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and (t2.tips_value != 'Mrk0101' or (t2.tips_value = 'Mrk0101' and t4.ref_id is not null))
